# GitHub MCP Server

MCP server for GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions. The coding wing (`nodes/coding/node.yaml`) serves it; `nodes/coding/node.yaml` `mcps.github-mcp` carries the same launch spec and wins at render.

The `mcp:` block launches GitHub's official native server with `github-mcp-server stdio`. The former npm reference package is deprecated and is retained only in historical device-probe evidence. Install a reviewed upstream release with its version and checksum recorded before this launcher is used on a wing. A render does not install or authenticate the binary.

The default server capability set is preserved; each action remains subject to connector-gate and repository review. For a read-only probe, upstream supports `--read-only`. Company PAT or OAuth authentication is a separate device gate; the public anonymous legacy probe does not satisfy it. See https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server for supported installation and authentication.

Env values are variable names; secrets live in the runtime env or Keychain. Nothing here grants a token: the tenant must enable `github-mcp` in `enabled.yaml` and `connector-gate` still runs before every call.

adapters.name: Claude Code
adapters.notes:
Skills load from ~/.claude/skills and <project>/.claude/skills. SKILL.md needs `name` and
`description` front matter. `.mcp.json` is shared with the team; secrets go in env vars, not the file.
adapters.plan_mode: Shift+Tab until the mode reads 'plan mode', or start with `claude --permission-mode plan`.

adapters.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
adapters.notes:
Codex has no plugin system; plugin cards render as install notes only. config.toml is shared
by every Codex session on this machine, so Snow Gloves appends missing tables and never rewrites
existing ones.
adapters.plan_mode: Type `/plan` (or pick Plan in the collaboration-mode picker). request_user_input is only offered in plan mode.

adapters.name: Cursor
adapters.notes:
Rules are .mdc files with `description`, `globs`, and `alwaysApply` front matter. The Snow Gloves
rule file is owned by Snow Gloves and rewritten on every render.
adapters.plan_mode: Switch the agent to Plan mode (mode picker or Shift+Tab); agents can also call SwitchMode to request it.
adapters.plugin_install: Install {id} from the Cursor plugin marketplace ({repo})

adapters.name: Any agent (portable fallback)
adapters.notes:
Everything renders inside the tenant folder. Copy or symlink the output into whatever runtime you
use. mcp.json uses the common `mcpServers` shape most clients accept.
adapters.plan_mode: If your runtime has a plan or read-only mode, turn it on. Otherwise, do not write files until the interview ends.

adapters.name: Grok CLI
adapters.notes:
Paths and tool names come from the Grok CLI user guide (~/.grok/docs/user-guide). The question
card times out after 30 minutes by default ([toolset.ask_user_question]).
adapters.plan_mode: Type `/plan` (or `/plan <description>`), or Shift+Tab from Normal to Plan.

install: hermes skills trust <project>   # loads ./.hermes/skills and ./.agents/skills from that repo
adapters.name: Hermes Agent
adapters.notes:
Install shape follows Factor: SOUL.md, config.yaml, and skills/ install as a Hermes profile
distribution (distribution.yaml). config.yaml carries comments and secrets, so Snow Gloves never
rewrites it; MCP entries are written as a sibling fragment to merge by hand. Hermes has no plan
mode; the interview runs as plain turns and uses `clarify` for each decision.

adapters.name: Muse
adapters.notes:
Placeholder. No Muse CLI was found on this machine and its skill/MCP conventions are not
confirmed. Every path is a guess shaped like the other runtimes; confirm before using --write.

adapters.name: OpenClaw
adapters.notes:
OpenClaw is a gateway agent (channels, plugins, skills). No structured question tool is known,
so the interview asks each decision as a numbered list and waits for a number.

adapters.name: OpenCode
adapters.notes:
The `question` tool is gated by `permission.question` in opencode.json. If it is denied, the
interview falls back to a numbered list. MCP entries use `command` as an array, not command+args.
adapters.plan_mode: Press Tab to switch to the built-in `plan` agent (read-only).
adapters.plugin_install: add "{id}" to the `plugin` array in opencode.json
